title: Steering Wheel Feel, Controls, and Heating
summary: Feedback in this topic centers on steering wheel feel and appearance, steering-wheel-mounted controls, and how the heated steering wheel is accessed or behaves.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the steering wheel’s feel, appearance, responsiveness, and controls.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on heated steering wheel controls being hard to find or poorly located.

mixed.summary: The mixed review describes malfunctioning steering wheel buttons alongside diagnostic and repair activity, without a clearly one-sided outcome.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews include observations about steering wheel heating behavior, button setup, stitching, softness, and generic mentions without clear sentiment.

limitations: Most sampled fragments in this topic are undetermined, which limits confidence in drawing a clear sentiment pattern from the examples.
Some example fragments are terse, ambiguous, or service-note style entries rather than full consumer opinions.
A few examples appear internally inconsistent or comparative in ways that make the target of sentiment unclear.
